Decoy and malformed-renderer regression tests are required.
Focused RBAC contract must run in PR validation for all changed Phase 0 paths.
Version-matched Argo v3.4.4 policy validation/evaluation is required before release.
next_action: Return to code: replace source-wide regexes with a scoped/rendered contract, add bypass regression tests, and wire it into PR validation; keep version-matched Argo evaluation as the test-stage gate.
